mapper.select: SELECT ID, KINDERGARTEN_ID, CLIENT, HOST, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CREATED_AT) * 1000 CREATED_AT FROM T_CHAT WHERE KINDERGARTEN_ID = #{kindergartenId} AND ((HOST = #{host} AND CLIENT = #{client}) OR (HOST = #{client} AND CLIENT = #{host})) ORDER BY ID LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_CHAT(KINDERGARTEN_ID, CLIENT, HOST) VALUES (#{kindergartenId}, #{client}, #{host})
